mapper.select: SELECT s.stu_id, s.stu_name, AVG(sc.score) AS avg_score FROM score sc LEFT JOIN student s ON sc.stu_id = s.stu_id GROUP BY s.stu_id, s.stu_name ORDER BY avg_score DESC
